cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll carry your book bag to the platform. My shoulder should manage one more staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it. There are dictionaries in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. No, keep your hands free for the tickets. I'll change shoulders at the bottom.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved our train to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, lead the way. I'll give each shoulder a staircase and rest my fingers while you find our seats.

mechanism: A performs competent luggage-handling and travel organisation while graciously carrying a growing burden and drawing attention to A bodily inconvenience.
confusable: D25 would pass work to B; here A insists on doing it and makes the strain visible while correcting the practical process.
comparison: Dinner alternative makes waiting visible through service order; station alternative distributes growing physical strain across the journey.
seedUse: Book bag, dictionaries, shoulder and changed platform derive from D45-b; S03 adds secure closure and ticket handling corrections.
